content: NDINYANGU AYWAA NDI KAT KƗTA VAPMBA YIGAT

Wuna mbaapma nɨmba, nɨna apma njambwi nyan Jisas Kraist kat ndɨ kat maawupmba yelavɨka lɨgangwuk. Nguk nat nyan kat nat vapmba yetɨga nat nyan kat nat vapmba yetɨngweyan kavle vatna. Jisas Kraist waa apma vak ana ndɨ.

Godna nyaangɨt wupmak yisolaa tɨngwa njɨmbla sanyo tɨga nyan yandeyan ndɨna apma waavwi yelaga nda vɨlaa mɨn apma tɨkɨtmba ndalɨ mɨla waa ke wangwa. Kavle waavwi tɨgiyaa nyan yandeyan mɨn kwo laataa tɨgiyamɨn. Wuna man kavamba ngay yapmba nda lɨgiyamɨn waa ke wangwa.
Mbɨk kat wupma wangweyan kavle vatna. Mbɨla mbangɨ mɨna vɨlaa nat nyan apma nyana nat nyan kavle nyana waa yelavɨka wana tɨngweyan.

Wuna mbaapma nɨmba, God wupma ana yelavɨka lɨgandɨ. Kan kɨpmana sanya lapman tɨga nɨmba God ndi kat kwutaa ndɨna mbaapmamba taagandɨ. Ndi kat apma maawut kwindɨ. Tak God wandɨ. Wun kat yelavɨka lɨga nɨmba ndi kat apma wenga nda kwilaa ndi kat vɨga lɨgiyowun waa wandɨ. Ndino ndi kat kwigiyandɨ.

God ndina sɨ kwutaa katsondɨ. Ngwuk ndina sɨ kwutaa manda kat viyesandangwuk. Sanya lɨga nɨmba ndina sɨ kwutaa manda kat katso lɨgangwuk. Ndi ngwuk kat apma vak ana yilɨgandi. Ngwuk kat kotmak kali lɨgandi.

Ndi sanyo lɨga nɨmba Godna sɨ kwutaa viyesanda lɨgandi. Ndɨ kavle nyan ana ndɨ. Ndɨna sɨ manda kat kwutaa viyesanda lɨgandi. Ndɨ God ngwuk kat apma vat yindɨ. Ngwuk kat kwutaa ndɨna mbaapmamba taagandɨ.

God waa angwa nyaangɨt lavu nyingamba tamba pɨlɨwutndi. Avla ngwula kwunatɨngwa vak nat nɨmba kat wupma kwunak kiyangwuk waa tamba pɨlɨwutndi. Wan nyaangɨt wutaa lɨga yetɨ ngwula. Wutaa yetɨngweyan apma vat yetɨgiyangwuk.
Nat nyan kat nat vapmba yiga nat nyan kat nat vapmba yilɨngweyan kavle vatna yilɨngwa. God waa nyaangɨt kat kaiwalaa kavle vapmba yilɨngangwuk.

Kɨta nyan God waa nyaangɨt aywaa wutaa lɨga kɨta nyaangɨt mɨna wupmak kat kai wandɨ. Nat nyan God waa nyaangɨt aywaa wupmak kat kai wandɨ. Vɨlɨlɨk palɨ kɨta vapmba tɨgambɨk. God waa nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai wambɨk.

Tamba God wandɨ. Yambɨsɨk yilɨnja vak ke yingwa. Nat nɨmba kat ke vatnyangwa waa tamba wandɨ. Yambɨsɨk yilɨnja vak yilapman tɨga nat nyan kat vatnyangweyan God walɨga nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai waa tɨga nɨmba vla lɨgangwuk.

Ngwuk yelavɨk ngwula. Ngɨni yaiga nandinya God nɨn kat vɨlaa sɨga naguga tɨgiyandɨ. Yilɨna vak kat vɨlaa lɨga God yelavɨk kiyandɨ. Nat nɨmba kat miwa yiga lɨga nɨmba ndi kat miwa yiga lɨga ana ndi kat sɨgiyowun waa yelavɨk kiyandɨ God. Ngi kat tɨga nat nɨmba kat miwa ay ngwula. Wupma yilɨngwa vak yilɨngweyan God ngwula kavle vak vɨlaa lɨga ngwuk kat aa sɨgiyandɨ.
GOD KAT MAAWUPMBA YELAVƗKA LƗGA APMA NJƗVWA AKWUK
Wuna mbaapma nɨmba, kɨta nyan laataa wun God kat wuna maawupmba yelavɨka lɨgowun waa walaa apma njɨvwa kwutapman yindeyan kavle vatna. Maawupmba yelavɨka tɨnda vak ndɨ kat ana kwunak kiyandɨ.
Ngwutna kɨta mbaapmana ndu lakwa waavwi kɨgɨnda lapman tɨga ngwuk kat yalaa wagalanjeyan ngwuk angamak yigiyangwuk.
Ndi kat kwi lapman kwo apma vat ay ngwula. Ngwutna mbangɨ apma vat tɨgiyandɨ. Ngwutna yat taak kiyandɨ waa kwo wangweyan di apma vat tɨgiyandi? Kai la. Apma vat ana tɨgiyandi. Kavle vat tɨgiyandi.
God kat maawupmba yelavɨka tɨngwa vak kɨta vatna. Maawupmba mɨna yelavɨka apma njɨvwa kwutapman yingweyan nat nyan kat ana kwunak kiyangwuk. Avla ngwutna maawut ana kwunak kiyangwuk.

Nat nyan laataa wandɨ. Mɨn walɨgamɨn. God kat maawupmba mɨna yelavɨka lɨgowun waa walɨgamɨn. Maawupmba yelavɨtɨma vak wuna mɨnimba ana vɨga lɨgowun. Anda vapmba vɨgiyowu. Wun apma njɨvwa kwutɨgowun. Kwutuwa apma njɨvwa vɨlaa God kat maawupmba yelavɨka tuwa vak vɨgiyamɨn vak nɨma vak ana ndɨ. God kɨta lɨgandɨ waa maawupmba yelavɨka tɨngwa vat apma vatna. Setena mbaapmamba nɨmba ndino wupma maawupmba yelavɨka tɨgandi. Yelavɨka lɨga God kat vaaka lɨga ndina ava pla lɨgandɨ.

Mbutwa nyaangɨt ngwuk ana yelavɨka lɨgangwuk. Apma njɨvwa kwut tapman tɨga God kat maawupmba mɨna yelavɨka lɨngwa vak apma vak ana ndɨ. Kwo vatnat. Tamba la nɨmba ya vak ngwuk kat mbukiyowun. Wutaa wuna nyaangɨt yelavɨka lɨgiyangwuk.
Nɨna tamba la walanga Ebraham God kat kwivat ndɨna nyan Isak kat vatnyavat tɨndɨ. Apma njɨvwa kwutndɨ mala God ndɨ kat vɨlaa apma nyan mɨn wandɨ.
Ndɨna maawupmba God kat yelavɨka lɨga God waa njɨvwa kwutndɨ. Kwo maawut mɨna ana yelavɨka lɨndɨ. Yelavɨka lɨga apma njɨvwa kwutndɨ.

Tamba la nɨmba pɨlɨwukna vak vla Ebraham ndɨno wupma yindɨ. kupma pɨlɨwutndi. Ebraham God kat maawupmba yelavɨka tɨndɨ maa God ndɨ kat vɨlaa mɨn apma nyan mɨn waa wandɨ waa tamba pɨlɨwutndi. God Ebraham kat wandɨ. Mɨn wuna alɨ nyan mɨn waa ana wandɨ. Ndɨna maawut tɨga vat ndɨna apma njɨvwa vɨlaa ndɨ kat mɨn apma nyan mɨn waa wandɨ God.

Tamba la yambɨsɨk yila taakwa Rehep lɨlo wupma yilɨlɨ. Josua ay wanda nɨmba lɨla ngay wuleindi mala ndi kat pakwulɨ. Pakwulaa yinjeya yambɨ vɨsɨmokwilɨ. Ndi kat apma vat yilangat ngɨni God wandɨ maa lɨ kat ana sɨndi. Kwo lɨlɨ.

Kɨta nyana wudumbu yindeyan ndɨna mbangɨ kiya nyan vla lɨgiyandɨ. Ndɨna mbangɨ wundumbu lapman tɨndeyan kiyaigandɨ. God kat maawupmba yelavɨtɨna vak kɨta vatna. Apma njɨvwa kwutapman tɨga God kat maawupmba yelavɨtneya vak kiya vak vla lɨgandɨ.
